description: This file defines classes and methods for handling regex pattern matching and routing for large language model (LLM) deployment configurations. It includes utilities for calculating pattern specificity, converting wildcard patterns to regex, and routing requests based on pattern matches to their respective deployment configurations.

classes.name: PatternUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for calculating pattern specificity and sorting patterns.

classes.name: PatternMatchRouter
classes.description: Main class handling regex pattern registration, matching, and routing for LLM deployment configurations, including converting wildcard patterns and setting deployment model names based on pattern matches.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] calculate_pattern_specificity(pattern: str)
methods.description: Calculates a tuple indicating the specificity of a regex pattern based on its length and regex complexity, used for sorting patterns.

methods.name: List[Tuple[str,List[Dict]]] sorted_patterns( patterns: Dict[str, List[Dict]] )
methods.description: Returns the list of patterns sorted by their calculated specificity.

methods.name: add_pattern(self, pattern: str, llm_deployment: Dict)
methods.description: Adds a new pattern and its associated deployment to the router's pattern dictionary.

methods.name: str _pattern_to_regex(self, pattern: str)
methods.description: Converts a wildcard pattern with '*' to an appropriate regex pattern string.

methods.name: List[Dict] _return_pattern_matched_deployments( self, matched_pattern: Match, deployments: List[Dict] )
methods.description: Creates a list of deployment copies with their 'model' parameter set based on the matched pattern groups.

methods.name: Optional[List[Dict]] route( self, request: Optional[str], filtered_model_names: Optional[List[str]] = None )
methods.description: Routes a request string to matching deployment configurations based on regex pattern matching, returning deployments if found.

methods.name: str set_deployment_model_name( matched_pattern: Match, litellm_deployment_litellm_model: str, )
methods.description: Sets the deployment model name by replacing wildcards in the model pattern with matched segments.

methods.name: Optional[List[Dict]] get_pattern( self, model: str, custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Checks whether a pattern exists for a given model and provider.

methods.name: List[Dict] get_deployments_by_pattern( self, model: str, custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Retrieves deployments based on matching pattern for a given model and provider.
